title.narrative: Cooperativas que cuidan: Tejiendo redes para el buen vivir

description.narrative: The project "Cooperatives that care: Weaving networks for good living" (2025-2028) seeks to strengthen a cooperative model of care with a community approach, promoting the dignified and professionalized work of women caregivers. It focuses on the training, visibility and organization of caregivers; the consolidation of Community Care Centers; financial sustainability through solidarity marketing and partnerships; and political advocacy to position care as a right and a key axis for social justice and the sustainability of life.
